tasks.gr9-social-environmental-responsibility-: Topic: Social and Environmental Responsibility. Cover community health, social pressure, environmental care, and responsible action. Ask learners to investigate community health issues, analyse how social and environmental conditions affect wellbeing, propose environmental solutions, create community campaign ideas, or reflect on their personal environmental impact.
tasks.gr9-sexuality-health-t2: Topic: Sexuality and Health. Cover puberty, sexual health, HIV and AIDS, consent, and teenage pregnancy. Ask learners to discuss sexual health accurately, challenge myths with facts, explain consent, analyse case studies about relationships, or discuss responsible and respectful choices.
tasks.gr9-substance-abuse-emotional-safety-t2: Topic: Substance Abuse and Emotional Safety. Cover alcohol, drugs, dependence, coping skills, and support services. Ask learners to identify warning signs of substance abuse, explain harmful effects, develop coping strategies, discuss peer pressure and refusal skills, or list support services and resources.
tasks.gr9-physical-education-task-2-t2: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 2. Cover sport skills, endurance, flexibility, and fair play. Ask learners to develop sport-specific skills, demonstrate endurance activities, complete flexibility assessments, reflect on fair play experiences, or analyse game-play strategies.
tasks.gr9-constitutional-values-role-models-t2: Topic: Constitutional values and role models (Grade 9 Life Orientation, Term 2). Cover the values of the Constitution (dignity, equality, non-racialism and non-sexism, rule of law), positive and negative role models, and applying values in daily life. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
tasks.gr9-national-days-t2: Topic: National and international days (Grade 9 Life Orientation, Term 2). Cover the dates and meaning of Human Rights Day, Freedom Day, Workers' Day, Africa Day, Youth Day, World Refugee Day, Nelson Mandela Day, Women's Day, Heritage Day and Reconciliation Day, respect for people with disabilities and people affected by HIV and AIDS, and planning a local celebration. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
tasks.gr9-nsc-and-ncv-t2: Topic: After Grade 9, the NSC and the NCV (Grade 9 Life Orientation, Term 2). Cover the National Senior Certificate (Grades 10 to 12 at school) and the National Certificate (Vocational) at TVET colleges, how they differ, and how to decide and apply. No admission thresholds. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
tasks.gr9-workplace-rights-t2: Topic: Rights, responsibilities and opportunities in the workplace (Grade 9 Life Orientation, Term 2). Cover workers' rights (safe workplace, fair pay, rest and leave, no discrimination), workers' responsibilities, and learnerships, apprenticeships, internships and starting a business. No wage figures, thresholds or section numbers. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
